challenges.name: cart-checkout-summary
challenges.title: Mini project: build the cart and its checkout summary
challenges.description: Put the whole course together in the Cho Xanh cart: products from a catalog with stock, add and remove with clear rejections, one saved voucher modelled as a sealed interface (percent off with a cap, amount off with a minimum, free shipping), and a checkout summary with money formatted by an extension function. Quantities already in the cart count against the stock, an unknown voucher keeps the saved one, shipping depends on the subtotal before the discount, and an empty cart says so. The test runner reads the catalog and the commands and prints every result.

tests.name: A normal cart with the TET10 voucher

product RAU-01 15000 120 Rau muong
product THIT-07 185000 20 Thit bo Uc
product TRUNG-10 30000 30 Trung ga ta
product GAO-05 240000 15 Gao ST25 tui 5kg
product SUA-01 32000 48 Sua tuoi TH 1l
product BO-A5 4500000 600 Bo Wagyu A5
add RAU-01 2
add THIT-07 1
voucher TET10
checkout
tests.expected:
added 2 x Rau muong
added 1 x Thit bo Uc
voucher TET10 saved
2 x Rau muong: 30,000 VND
1 x Thit bo Uc: 185,000 VND
subtotal: 215,000 VND
discount TET10: -21,500 VND
shipping: 15,000 VND
total: 208,500 VND
